history.summary: The sister listing to 79 Chay Yan St — a 1967 Tiong Bahru SIT walk-up on a 99yr lease from 1967 (~40 years remaining), conservation-gazetted so no en-bloc, at $1.15M / $1272 PSF. The same lease-decay and financing problems make this an own-stay/heritage piece, not a 5-7yr investment.
history.rating_rationale: ~40 years of lease left restricts bank financing (lower LTV/shorter tenor), narrowing the buyer pool and guaranteeing lease-decay drag over the hold. Conservation gazette eliminates en-bloc upside. Walk-up, no lift/facilities, 800m to Havelock MRT. Lowest score in the batch at 330/1000 with a 166-251 record. Even at the slightly lower $1272 PSF, the structural lease/financing problems dominate.
red_flags: ~40 years lease remaining — restricted financing, accelerating lease decay
No URA data; weakest score in batch (330)
catalysts: Tiong Bahru heritage appeal to niche lifestyle buyers
Central D03, near Havelock MRT (TEL) and Greater Southern Waterfront
